about.title: About Me
about.text: Here you will meet a developer who deeply loves what she does. To me, our field is a playground that never stops moving, which is why I am always looking to learn and push myself further. Beyond the lines of code, you will discover a whole person, calm and guided by an insatiable curiosity and a deep desire to do things well. Day to day, I approach tech with a lot of rigor and independence, but what I love most is the feeling of freedom when I build a robust application from a simple idea. That same spark drives me when I venture into entrepreneurship or work on improving my English. And to fuel all this energy, I regularly escape into the vibrant world of music, mainly K-pop, a culture whose creativity inspires me far more often than people might think.
